text: ポケモンずかん　つくっとるか　なら　わしから　アドバイスじゃ！

structure.jp: ポケモンずかん　つくっとるか
わしから　アドバイスじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man dialect form of ている, which shows something is going on now. つくっとる = 'are making'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら picks up what was just said and means 'if that is so'. なら わしから アドバイスじゃ = 'in that case, here's advice from me'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ, 'is'. アドバイスじゃ = 'it's advice'.
